timing_component_definition: preparation_seconds = inclusive native point total - (bench + prewarm); bench_* nested fields are never added separately. Shared worker residual setup is excluded from this fit.
measurement_precision: Original native phase logs round to 0.01 seconds. Derived errors are against those logged observations, not sub-rounding precision or confidence bounds.

fit_policy.method: unweighted ordinary least squares, affine intercept plus past-history tokens per request
fit_policy.first_use_exclusion: Exclude exactly the first chronological point in each native worker, identified by original sample order/index 0 before fitting. Keep its measured cost separately. This is a declared first-use stratum, not residual-driven outlier rejection; its warm cost is not predicted.
fit_policy.holdout_policy: Preserve preassigned normalizer roles: indices 4,9,14,19 are held out in each original 22-point worker. After first-use exclusion, 17 fit + 4 held-out observations remain.
fit_policy.independent_group_validation: unavailable; only one production worker per variant, no independent held-out fresh group

qualification_limits: Conditional on chronological first-use work being separately accounted; no independent validation of that decomposition across fresh workers.
Only same B300, SGLang, exact NVFP4 checkpoint/local geometry, precision and variant within observed warm history range; no cross-batch, cross-model, BF16-checkpoint, framework or system transfer.
Full/skip-indexer variants fit independently. Forward latency is already part of native inclusive clocks and is never added here.
A preparation component is not a full collection GPU-hour estimate. Execution, worker initialization growth, failures, memory admission and cold-use repetition remain separate.
Point gate uses rounded phase logs; it is not a confidence interval or proof of fresh-group reproducibility.
